cardEffects: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing 1 card in your hand, until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains "[End of Attack] Delete this Digimon."

jp.captionText: EX-06: Theme Booster Infernal Ascension (JP Sample)

inheritedEffect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon attacks, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon, end the attack.
name: Witchmon

rulings.answer: Yes, it activates.  Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of their Digimon gains that effect, so the [End of Attack] effect will activate even if the affected Digimon digivolves or de-digivolves.
rulings.question: A Digimon affected by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect attacked the opponent player, then a [Security] effect gave this Digimon ＜De-Digivolve  1＞ nocategory of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) and trashed it. Does the [End of Attack] effect activate in such cases?

rulings.answer: No, this effect triggers simultaneously with [When Attacking] effects. The turn player's effects will resolve first, then this effect will resolve, then the attack will end.
rulings.question: When an opponent's Digimon attacks, can this card's inherited effect end the attack before [When Attacking] effects activate?

rulings.answer: No. After the battle is resolved, the timing for activation of effects has already passed, so the effect can't activate.
rulings.question: When an opponent's Digimon attacks, can I activate this card's inherited effect after comparing DP for the battle and end the attack at that timing?

rulings.answer: No. The attack is considered to occur, therefore [When Attacking] effects and other processes are still performed.
rulings.question: When this card's inherited effect activates, is an attack considered to have never occurred?

rulings.answer: No, you can't.  <Blast Digivolve> is performed at the end of the counter timing. If you activate this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect, the attack will end before [Counter] effects trigger during the counter timing, therefore <Blast Digivolve> can no longer be performed.
rulings.question: Can I use <Blast Digivolve> to digivolve my Digimon if I activate this card's inherited effect and end the attack from an opponent's Digimon?
Do [End of Attack] effects activate if I activate this card's inherited effect and end the attack from an opponent's Digimon?
